newsitem.title: USA: Fed adds reserves via 14-day fixed system RPs.
newsitem.headline: Fed adds reserves via 14-day fixed system RPs.

text.p: The Federal Reserve added reserves to the banking system Tuesday via 14-day fixed system repurchase agreements, a Fed spokeswoman said.
The add move was in line with the market's expectations, although some analysts had forecast the Fed would inject reserves through nine-day fixed system repurchase agreements.
At 1030 EST/1530 GMT, the time the Fed usually intervenes in the market, federal funds traded at 5-3/16 percent, below the Fed's 5-1/4 percent target.
